title: Admin Change Vendor Status (Active ↔ Inactive) - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin Change Vendor Status feature covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for status dropdown, confirmation warning for active inquiries, status change announcements, error rollback, and logged status changes.

testCases.title: Status dropdown keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is viewing an Active vendor
steps: 1. Tab to status dropdown
2. Verify focus indicator visible with 3:1 contrast
3. Verify dropdown has accessible name ('Vendor Status' or similar)
4. Press Enter/Space to open dropdown
5. Use Arrow keys to navigate options (Active, Inactive)
6. Press Enter to select option
7. Verify Escape closes dropdown without change

testCases.title: Status dropdown has proper ARIA attributes
testCases.preconditions: Admin is viewing an Active vendor
steps: 1. Inspect status dropdown
2. Verify role='combobox' or role='listbox' or native <select>
3. Verify aria-expanded toggles on open/close
4. Verify aria-label or associated label present
5. Verify selected option has aria-selected='true'
6. Use screen reader to verify current value announced

testCases.title: Status dropdown available only for Active vendors
testCases.componentElement: Status dropdown visibility by vendor status
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Vendor Lists page
steps: 1. Navigate to Active Partners tab — verify dropdown present
2. Navigate to Pending tab — verify dropdown NOT present
3. Navigate to Rejected tab — verify dropdown NOT present
4. Navigate to Inactive tab — verify dropdown present (to reactivate)
expectedResults: Dropdown present on Inactive vendors (for reactivation)
Dropdown NOT present on Pending/Rejected vendors

testCases.title: Warning dialog for active inquiries accessible
testCases.componentElement: Warning dialog when deactivating vendor with active inquiries
testCases.preconditions: Admin changes status to Inactive for vendor with active inquiries
steps: 1. Change status to Inactive for vendor with active inquiries
2. Verify warning dialog appears
3. Verify dialog has role='alertdialog'
4. Verify dialog has accessible name
5. Verify warning text explains consequences
6. Verify focus moves to dialog
7. Verify Confirm and Cancel buttons keyboard accessible
8. Verify Escape closes dialog
9. Verify focus returns to dropdown on cancel
expectedResults: Warning dialog appears for vendors with active inquiries
Focus returns to trigger on close

testCases.title: Status change success announced
steps: 1. Confirm status change (Active → Inactive or Inactive → Active)
2. Verify success message appears
3. Verify message has role='status' or aria-live='polite'
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
5. Verify message text clear (e.g., 'Vendor status changed to Inactive')
6. Verify message has 4.5:1 contrast

testCases.title: Status change failure with rollback accessible
testCases.componentElement: Error message on status change failure
testCases.preconditions: Status change fails due to system error
steps: 1. Trigger status change that fails
2. Verify error message appears
3. Verify UI reverts to previous status
4. Verify error has role='alert' or aria-live='assertive'
5. Verify error announced immediately by screen reader
6. Verify error text explains failure
7. Verify error has 4.5:1 contrast

testCases.title: Deactivation consequences communicated accessibly
testCases.preconditions: Admin is about to deactivate a vendor
steps: 1. Initiate deactivation
2. Verify consequences listed (products hidden, no new products, no replies, notifications sent)
3. Verify consequences text accessible to screen readers
4. Verify consequences not conveyed by color alone
5. Verify text has 4.5:1 contrast
expectedResults: All consequences accessible to screen readers

testCases.title: Reactivation restores access announced
testCases.preconditions: Admin changes Inactive vendor back to Active
steps: 1. Change Inactive vendor to Active
2. Verify success message indicates access restored
3. Verify message announced by screen reader
4. Verify vendor moves to Active tab
5. Verify tab counts update

testCases.title: Status change logged and accessible
steps: 1. View vendor details after status change
2. Verify status change logged with timestamp
3. Verify log entry has label and date
4. Use screen reader to verify log accessible
5. Verify log text has 4.5:1 contrast
expectedResults: Log entry has label and date

testCases.title: Status not conveyed by color alone
testCases.preconditions: Admin is viewing vendors with different statuses
steps: 1. View Active vendor — verify text label 'Active' present
2. View Inactive vendor — verify text label 'Inactive' present
3. Verify status not conveyed by color alone (green/red)
4. Test in grayscale mode — verify statuses distinguishable
5. Verify status text has 4.5:1 contrast
expectedResults: Status not conveyed by color alone

testCases.title: Focus management after status change
steps: 1. Change vendor status
2. If vendor moves to different tab, verify focus managed
3. Verify focus not lost on moved element
4. Verify user can continue keyboard navigation

testCases.title: Loading state during status change accessible
steps: 1. Initiate status change
2. Verify loading indicator appears
3. Verify loading announced via aria-live
4. Verify dropdown disabled during processing
5. Verify completion announced

testCases.title: Text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: All text related to status change
testCases.preconditions: Admin is viewing vendor with status dropdown
steps: 1. Measure dropdown text contrast
2. Measure warning dialog text contrast
3. Measure success/error message contrast
4. Measure status label contrast

testCases.title: Status change usable at 200% zoom
testCases.componentElement: Status dropdown and dialogs at 200% zoom
steps: 1. Set browser zoom to 200%
2. Verify dropdown visible and usable
3. Open warning dialog — verify visible
4. Verify no horizontal scrolling
5. Verify no text truncation

testCases.title: NVDA screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: NVDA enabled, Admin viewing Active vendor
steps: 1. Navigate to status dropdown with NVDA
2. Verify dropdown announced with current value
3. Open dropdown — verify options announced
4. Select Inactive — verify warning dialog announced
5. Confirm — verify success announced
6. Verify status change announced

testCases.title: JAWS screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: JAWS enabled, Admin viewing Active vendor
steps: 1. Navigate to status dropdown with JAWS
2. Verify dropdown accessible in forms mode
3. Change status
4. Verify all dialogs and messages announced
5. Verify status change announced

testCases.title: No keyboard traps in status change flow
testCases.preconditions: Admin is interacting with status dropdown
steps: 1. Open dropdown — verify Escape closes it
2. Open warning dialog — verify Escape closes it
3. Verify focus returns to trigger after close
4. Verify no element traps focus

testCases.title: Mobile touch target adequate
steps: 1. Set viewport to mobile (375x667)
2. Verify dropdown touch target at least 44x44px
3. Verify dialog buttons meet 44x44px
4. Verify no horizontal scrolling
